definition: [ נוּן , נִין ] verb propagate, increase (si vera lectio) ( > denominative from נין Hup-Now SS ; — Late Hebrew נוּן = fish , so Aramaic נוּנָא , , Assyrian nunu ; — Qal or Hiph`il ?) Imperfect ינין Kt ; > Niph`al ינּוֺן Qr Ps 72:17 let his name have increase (or, if Niph`al, be propagated, spread ); but dubious, Vrss perhaps יִכּוֺן be established, endure .
